## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Adhikaraṇavāra* is the fourteenth section of the first division of the *Parivāra*, the closing analytical compendium of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. Functioning as a technical monastic catechism, the text systematically classifies and relates the various rules and disciplinary offenses of the Vinaya to the four established categories of legal procedure (*adhikaraṇa*). A complete modern English translation has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
